Sale.title: Sale
Sale.description: A daily or transaction-level tea shop sales record

userId.description: The UID of the shop owner who recorded the sale

date.description: Date of the sales entry in YYYY-MM-DD format

note.description: Optional note or sales source (e.g., Counter cash, UPI)

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 string

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: An expense record for the tea shop (ingredients, utilities, rent, staff salary, etc.)

userId.description: The UID of the shop owner who recorded the expense

name.description: Name or item description of the expense

category.description: Category such as Milk, Tea powder, Sugar, Gas, Staff salary, etc.

date.description: Date of expense in YYYY-MM-DD format

description.description: Optional detailed notes or invoice number

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 string

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Shop settings and custom categories for the tea shop owner

userId.description: The UID of the shop owner

shopName.description: Display name of the tea shop

customCategories.description: List of user-defined custom expense categories

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 string

Worker.title: Worker
Worker.description: Employee profile for tea stall staff and helpers

userId.description: The UID of the shop owner

wageAmount.description: Daily wage rate or monthly base salary in INR

offDayPaid.description: Whether weekly off days are paid or unpaid

prorationMethod.description: Monthly salary calculation divisor: calendar_days, fixed_30, or working_26

joiningDate.description: Date worker joined in YYYY-MM-DD format

notes.description: Optional notes or role info (e.g., Master Chai Maker, Table cleaner)

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 string

Attendance.title: Attendance
Attendance.description: Daily attendance record for a worker

userId.description: The UID of the shop owner

date.description: Date of attendance in YYYY-MM-DD format

status.description: Status: present, half_day, absent, or off

wageMultiplier.description: Multiplier for wage calculation (e.g. 1.0 for present, 0.5 for half day, 0 for absent)

notes.description: Optional notes (e.g. morning half day, personal leave)

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 string

ShopStatus.title: ShopStatus
ShopStatus.description: Daily operational status of the tea shop (open, holiday, weekly_off)

userId.description: The UID of the shop owner

date.description: Date of shop status in YYYY-MM-DD format

isPaid.description: Whether this holiday or off is paid to workers

holidayName.description: Optional festival or reason for closure

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 string

SalaryAdvance.title: SalaryAdvance
SalaryAdvance.description: Worker advance payment or deduction record

userId.description: The UID of the shop owner

amount.description: Advance or deduction amount in INR

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 string

SalaryPayment.title: SalaryPayment
SalaryPayment.description: Recorded salary settlement paid to a worker

userId.description: The UID of the shop owner

paymentDate.description: Date payment was settled in YYYY-MM-DD format

expenseId.description: Linked business expense ID in expenses collection

notes.description: Optional payment notes (e.g. Paid in cash, UPI)

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 string

/users/{userId}/sales/{saleId}.description: Collection of sales records created by the shop owner

/users/{userId}/expenses/{expenseId}.description: Collection of expense records created by the shop owner

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingDoc}.description: User preferences and tea shop configuration

/users/{userId}/workers/{workerId}.description: Tea shop staff and worker profiles

/users/{userId}/attendance/{attendanceId.description: Daily worker attendance records (present, half_day, absent, off)

/users/{userId}/shopStatus/{date}.description: Daily shop operational status (open, holiday, weekly_off)

/users/{userId}/salaryAdvances/{advanceI.description: Worker salary advances and deduction entries

/users/{userId}/salaryPayments/{paymentI.description: Settled salary disbursements linked with business expenses
